package.description: A modern Rust/Tauri desktop frontend for watching Twitch streams via Streamlink.

en-US.description: A modern Rust/Tauri desktop frontend for watching Twitch streams via Streamlink.
en-US.name: Stream GUI RS
en-US.releaseNotes:
Stream GUI RS 1.8.0
Changes since Stream GUI RS 1.7.1.
This feature release can show the Twitch broadcaster, category and stream title in the mpv window title.
Features
- Added Settings → Playback → Show stream details in mpv title (#108, #107). It is off by default. When enabled and mpv is the selected player, Twitch playback shows broadcaster - category - stream title in the mpv window title. Other players, Kick and YouTube are unchanged. Save the setting and select Restart in Watching to apply it to a running session.
Documentation
- Explained how unauthenticated Twitch playback affects ad breaks and the highest available qualities, and why signed-in Twitch playback is deferred (#107).
Dependencies
- Updated webbrowser to 1.2.6, uuid to 1.29.1, toml to 1.2.1 and other locked Rust dependencies (#99, #100, #103, #106).
- Updated Vitest to 5.1.0, @vitejs/plugin-react to 6.2.1 and CI tooling (#101, #102, #104, #105).
Upgrade and platform support
Settings move from schema 10 to schema 11 when settings are next saved; existing values are unchanged and the new option starts off. Upgrade without signing out or clearing settings. Older versions reject the schema 11 settings file without overwriting it.
Streamlink 8.0+ and a separately installed player remain required. Package formats remain Windows x86_64 installer and portable/Scoop ZIP; Linux x86_64 AppImage, DEB and RPM; and a universal macOS DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel requiring macOS 11.0 or later. Verify downloads against the accompanying SHA-256 files.
